english.title: Occupier fail to maintain destroyed / altered fish dam
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in any waters frequented by salmon or migratory trout, the occupier for the time being of

(A)_[a dam which from any cause had been destroyed]_
(B)_[a dam which from any cause had been taken down to the extent of one-half of its length was rebuilt or reinstated]_

and being required by the appropriate agency to make a fish pass for salmon or migratory trout of such form or dimensions as the appropriate agency may approve as part of the structure of, or in connection with, the dam and thereafter maintain it in an efficient state, failed to

(C)_[make such a fish pass]_
(D)_[maintain such a fish pass in an efficient state]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 9(1)(b) and (2) of the Salmon and Freshwater Fisheries Act 1975.
